daily.title: Daily orientation
daily.description: What matters today: due tasks, appointments and what you worked on lately.
daily.prompt: What matters today? Give me a short orientation: what is due or scheduled today and in the next two days, what I worked on lately and what the most important next step is. Use my daily note, my tasks and my appointments. At most five points, each with its source.

weekly.title: Weekly review
weekly.description: The past seven days and the week ahead.
weekly.prompt: Review my week: what I worked on in the last seven days (notes I created or changed), which tasks I completed and which are still open or overdue, and my appointments in the coming week. End with three suggestions for next week. Cite the notes.

project.title: Project status
project.description: Goal, progress, open points and the next step of a project.
project.prompt: What is the status of the project in the open note? Goal, what is done, what is open, what blocks it and the next step — each point with its source. If the open note is not about a project, ask me which project I mean.
project.promptFor: What is the status of the project “{{project}}”? Goal, what is done, what is open, what blocks it and the next step — each point with its source.
project.argument: The project: the name of its note or folder.

meeting.title: Meeting preparation
meeting.description: Prepare a meeting or write it up: what it is about, what changed since last time, open points.
meeting.prompt: Prepare my next meeting: what it is about, what changed since the last one, which points and tasks are open and what I should bring. If the open note is a meeting that already took place, write up its decisions and next steps instead.
meeting.promptFor: Prepare the meeting “{{meeting}}”: what it is about, what changed since the last one, which points and tasks are open and what I should bring.
meeting.argument: The meeting: its title, or the name of its note.

triage.title: Task triage
triage.description: Sort the open tasks: what now, what can wait, what to drop.
triage.prompt: Sort my open tasks: what should I do now, what can wait, what could I drop or hand over, and which tasks need a date?

writing.title: Write and rewrite
writing.description: Summarise, shorten or rewrite a note — as text to take over.
writing.prompt: Help me with the text of the open note: summarise it in a few sentences and suggest a clearer version, without changing any fact.

upkeep.title: Knowledge upkeep
upkeep.description: Find notes that say the same, are out of date or unconnected.
upkeep.prompt: Look after my vault: which recently changed notes say the same thing, are out of date or are not connected to anything? A suggestion for each.

links.title: Link cleanup
links.description: Check the links of the open note: broken, missing, one-way.
links.prompt: Check the links of the open note: which lead nowhere, which mentions could be links, and which notes should link to each other?

memory.title: Memory care
memory.description: Find entries of the memory that say the same, contradict each other or are out of date.
memory.prompt: Look through my memory: which entries say the same thing, contradict each other or are out of date? Draft what to merge and what to take out.

privacy.title: Privacy check
privacy.description: Find what in a note should stay on this device.
privacy.prompt: Check the open note for personal data, numbers, passwords or health details that should not go to a cloud, and suggest a rule for each.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.description: Look back on your notes of a day or a week — kindly, without a diagnosis.
reflection.prompt: Reflect with me on my daily notes of the last seven days: what stands out, what went well, what seems to weigh on me, and a few questions to think on.

research.title: Research
research.description: Research a question on the web and in your notes, with every source named.
research.prompt: I want to research something on the web and in my notes. If the open note names the topic, research it; otherwise ask me what to look for.

mailcal.title: Mail and calendar
mailcal.description: Go through recent mail and the coming appointments: what needs an answer, what to prepare, which tasks follow.
mailcal.prompt: Go through my mail of the last three days and my appointments of the coming week: what needs an answer, what should I prepare, and which tasks follow from it?

settings.textFileExtensionsDesc: Extra extensions Plainva opens itself instead of handing them to the system — comma separated. The built-in list (.txt, .csv, .json, source code …) always stays.
settings.autoOpenLastVaultDesc: Unchecked, Plainva always starts on the vault chooser screen.

okfInfo.title: What is OKF?
okfInfo.short1: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) is an open convention for Markdown collections: plain files with a small, uniform frontmatter header.
okfInfo.short2: Every note Plainva creates carries one field — “type”. The bundle version lives once in the root index.md, and existing files are never changed unasked.
okfInfo.short3: That reliable structure is what databases, filters, templates and index.md navigation build on — and it stays plain Markdown that other tools read.
okfInfo.settingsDesc: In short: type, provenance and review marks, the bundle version and index.md management.

binding.title: An artifact belongs to another workspace
binding.explain: {{kind}}: the file names a different workspace id than this vault. It comes from another encrypted vault or was put into the wrong cloud folder.

pathHash.title: An artifact does not match its file name
pathHash.explain: {{kind}}: the file name carries a checksum that does not match the content. The file was renamed or changed on the way.

signature.title: A signature is invalid
signature.explain: {{kind}}: the signature of the device that wrote the file cannot be confirmed. Either the content was changed, or the device's key is not the expected one.

policyChain.title: A policy that does not continue the accepted one
policyChain.explain: A policy version does not build on the chain this device accepted. It comes from a diverged state and is not adopted.

policyUnaccepted.title: Changes use a policy this device has not accepted yet
policyUnaccepted.explain: {{device}} wrote with policy version {{policy}}; accepted here is {{accepted}}. Usually a newer member or a policy change that has not reached this device yet.
policyUnaccepted.hint: After the next policy refresh this usually resolves itself — “Check again” triggers exactly that refresh. If it stays, check under “Devices” whether {{device}} still belongs to the workspace.

authorNotActive.title: Changes from a device that is no longer active
authorNotActive.explain: {{device}} is no longer listed as an active device in the policy. Its changes are not adopted.
authorNotActive.hint: If the device was removed, this is correct. If it should write again, pair it again under “Devices”.

postRevocation.title: Changes from a device after it was revoked
postRevocation.explain: {{device}} lost access. These changes lie beyond the point an authorized device last witnessed for it — they are not adopted.
postRevocation.hint: This is the normal outcome of a revocation and needs no action. Ignore the group if the revocation was intended. If the device should write again, pair it anew under “Devices”.

capability.title: A change the device was not allowed to make
capability.explain: {{device}} wrote something its role does not permit. The change stays out.
capability.hint: If the device should be allowed, change its role under “People & permissions” and check again.

missingParents.title: Changes whose predecessors are missing
missingParents.explain: These changes build on revisions this device does not know. The predecessors have not arrived yet or are gone from the cloud.
missingParents.hint: Waiting and “Check again” usually suffices — the predecessors come with the next refresh. If they stay missing, a device never uploaded them.

chainGap.title: Changes from one device are waiting: the chain is broken
chainGap.explain: This device expects change no. {{expected}} from {{device}}; the cloud holds no. {{found}}. Whatever is missing or replaced in between blocks everything after it — the group covers {{count}} changes.
chainGap.hint: On a device that still holds the complete verified history, choose Sync now. Plainva can restore missing signed operations from that copy. Then check again on {{device}}. If no valid copy exists, keep or export the local data; verification is never reset to bypass the gap.

chainBlocked.title: Waiting behind a gap
chainBlocked.explain: This change is fine but stands behind a gap in its device's chain. It is adopted as soon as the gap closes.

payloadMissing.title: The content of a change is missing from the cloud
payloadMissing.explain: The change points at an object that is not in the cloud or was altered. The upload is incomplete or was touched from outside.
payloadMissing.hint: Let the device that wrote the change sync once more; it re-uploads the missing object. Then “Check again”.

envelope.title: An encrypted object does not match its change
envelope.explain: The encrypted envelope names a different workspace, object or revision than the change claims. The pair is not adopted.

rollback.title: A device reports an older state than known
rollback.explain: The pointer of {{device}} in the cloud is behind what this device has already seen. A jump backwards is not adopted — it looks like a cloud that was rolled back.

checkpointMissing.title: A checkpoint is missing from the cloud
checkpointMissing.explain: A device points at a checkpoint that is not in the cloud or was altered.

unreadable.title: A file cannot be read
unreadable.explain: {{kind}}: the file is not a valid Plainva artifact — damaged, truncated or written by a newer app version.
unreadable.hint: If Plainva is newer on another device, update this one. Otherwise export the diagnosis; it helps with the investigation.

unknown.title: A check failed
unknown.hint: Export the diagnosis and check again. If nothing changes, the export helps with the investigation.

whatsNew.title: What's new in Plainva {{version}}
whatsNew.highlight1: Jot down thoughts with a timestamp in your daily note — by shortcut, from the share menu or your home screen. The journal view shows every day as a list or a card wall, with your mood and a day that ends when you say.
whatsNew.highlight2: Today, Upcoming and Inbox sort your tasks. Type “Send offer tomorrow 14:30 !!!” and Plainva sets the date, time and priority; reminders and the states “in progress” and “cancelled” join them.
whatsNew.highlight3: Today shows your appointments and tasks, Quick capture opens a task or the journal in one tap; the iPhone adds two lock-screen widgets. What you tick off in a widget, Plainva applies the next time it opens.
whatsNew.highlight4: Record voice notes in Plainva and play them in the editor, on the pinboard and in the journal. If you want, a location stamp adds your approximate position — off by default.
whatsNew.highlight5: Every database view has a search field, ratings are an input type of their own, and file.day places daily notes in calendar and timeline. Write pinboard entries in the full editor; kanban cards carry the note colour.
whatsNew.highlight6: Arabic, Hebrew and Persian run right to left, paragraph by paragraph. Search now finds Japanese, Chinese and Thai words in the middle of a sentence.
whatsNew.highlight7: New mail accounts can be set up on desktop again, and saving an account keeps its calendar and task lists. Events with an online meeting show Join; meeting notes start from your template.
whatsNew.highlight8: In 0.8.3 a synced note could disappear after you moved or renamed it (WebDAV and S3). That is fixed: the sync now checks every deletion file by file, and folders with accented names no longer turn up twice. Please update all your devices.

rules.graphHint: Rules stored with the provider also run while Plainva is closed (Microsoft). Plainva only replaces the rules it created itself.

trust.title: Trust & provenance
trust.verifierPromptBody: Plainva records your name with every review you mark (verified: human:<name>). The name is kept on this device for this vault.

window.openVaultWindow: Open vault in a new window
window.vaultNestedInside: This vault lies inside “{{other}}”, which is already open. Two vaults may not overlap.
window.vaultNestedContains: This vault contains “{{other}}”, which is already open. Two vaults may not overlap.
window.restoreWindowsDesc: Reopens the auxiliary windows you had open when the app starts. Unsent messages are never restored.
window.noVaultBody: This window is not showing a vault right now. Pick a recent one or choose a folder.
window.revealNoTree: No window with a file tree is showing this vault.
window.ownerUnreachable: The main window is not responding.
window.transferFailed: The transfer did not complete. The source tab and its draft are retained.
window.transferUnknown: The main window has not confirmed yet. Your draft stays here; check the status again.
window.transferPending: Transferring the tab. It stays open here until the main window confirms receipt.

commentNotify.enableHint: Plainva has no server, so a remark is noticed during a sync cycle. On the desktop that is almost at once; the phone notices when you open it.
commentNotify.levelAllHint: Every new remark in this vault.
commentNotify.levelMentionsHint: Only when somebody writes @ and your name.
commentNotify.levelRelevantHint: Mentions, replies in threads you wrote in, remarks on your notes, and verdicts on your suggestions.
commentNotify.preview: Show note and text in the notification
commentNotify.previewHint: Off, a notification only says that something arrived — no name, no note title, no text. A locked vault never previews.

connection.loginFailed: The connection could not be completed. Your entries are kept. Try again.
connection.accountChanged: The target account or vault changed. Open the intended account again.
connection.wrongAccount: You signed in to a different account. Choose the displayed account when signing in again.
connection.needsConsent: This service needs a new authorization. Sign in again and allow the requested access.
connection.identityUnavailable: The account identity could not be verified. Sign in to the provider again.
connection.storageFailed: Storage could not be confirmed. Try again; setup will resume the same connection.
connection.signedInNotSaved: The sign-in worked, but the account data could not be saved on this device. Nothing was left half-created.
connection.transferSummary: {{source}} → {{target}}. {{local}} local files, {{remote}} cloud files, {{conflicts}} collisions. The source vault is kept. Calendars and email will be set up in the destination.
connection.transferCopy: Local file as a separate copy
connection.transferKeepHint: Review both contents. “Keep both files” preserves the local file at the new path shown.
connection.transferChanged: Files or the destination changed since the preview. Restart copying and review the updated preview.
connection.transferAccountCollision: The destination has a different account binding. Open its account settings and resolve the binding before copying.
connection.transferInventoryFailed: The storage location could not be read completely. Check the connection and access permissions, then try again.
connection.transferPairRequired: This cloud folder is encrypted. Open the existing vault through “Security & Sharing” and pair this device before adding content.
connection.clipboardFailed: The path could not be copied. Select and copy it in the file details.
connection.googleClientUnsupported: The Google registration does not match this device’s return path. Check the client type and mobile setup in the Google guide.

connectionFailure.TLS_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED: The server certificate has expired. Renew it on the server.
connectionFailure.TLS_CERTIFICATE_NOT_YET_VALID: The server certificate is not valid yet. Check the device clock and certificate dates.
connectionFailure.TLS_HOSTNAME_MISMATCH: The certificate does not match the server address. Check the address and certificate.
connectionFailure.TLS_CERTIFICATE_UNTRUSTED: The certificate authority is not trusted on this device. Check the server certificate chain and installed CAs.
connectionFailure.TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED: The secure connection could not be verified. Check the server certificate and TLS configuration.
connectionFailure.HTTP_ORIGIN_BLOCKED: The connection or redirect was blocked because its origin was not allowed. Check the configured server address.
connectionFailure.HTTP_TIMEOUT: The server did not respond in time. Plainva will retry.
connectionFailure.HTTP_NETWORK_ERROR: The network connection failed. Plainva will retry when the connection is available.
connectionFailure.HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed. Check the connection settings and diagnostic export.

workspaceSync.transient: The connection is temporarily unavailable. Plainva will try again automatically; pending changes stay on this device.
workspaceSync.authentication: Sign in to the sync account again. Pending changes stay on this device until access is restored.
workspaceSync.integrity: Plainva cannot verify the encrypted workspace. Synchronization is paused; local data and pending changes are preserved. Open Security & Sharing, restore a verified copy if available, then check again.
workspaceSync.fatal: Synchronization is paused until the connection problem is resolved. Local data and pending changes are preserved. Check the connection, then try again.
workspaceSync.foreignLegacy: Unencrypted remark files from other devices remain on the server. Only their originating device can finish the conversion. Plainva does not delete another device's files.

noteEmbed.depth: The maximum embed depth has been reached.
noteEmbed.ambiguous: “{{target}}” matches more than one note. Use a vault-relative path.

searchResults.changed: The occurrence is no longer present in the changed text.

driveDestination.title: Choose Drive folder
driveDestination.effect: After confirmation, Plainva reconciles this vault with the selected folder. Check its existing files. Other cloud folders are neither moved nor deleted.

shareInbox.title: Shared content
shareInbox.locked: This vault is locked. Your content keeps waiting on this device.
shareInbox.otherVault: This transfer belongs to another vault. Open that vault to continue.
shareInbox.targetChanged: Different content now exists at the destination. The waiting copy is preserved; nothing was overwritten.
shareInbox.writeFailed: The transfer could not finish. Your waiting content is preserved.
shareInbox.indexIssue: Saved. The search index could not be updated yet.
shareInbox.incomplete: The transfer is incomplete. Share the original content again; received parts remain until discarded.
shareInbox.discardHint: Remove only this waiting entry from the device? Files already written to the vault will remain.
shareInbox.readFailed: Waiting content could not be read. It has not been removed.

inputRejected.attachmentHeader: The attachment name or type is invalid. Rename the file or choose another attachment.
inputRejected.calendarMethod: The calendar invitation could not be prepared because its message type is invalid.
inputRejected.imapValue: The search text, folder name or account details contain unsupported characters. Remove line breaks and try again.
inputRejected.smtpValue: A sender or recipient contains invalid characters. Check the mail addresses and try again.

voiceMemo.denied: Without access to the microphone Plainva cannot record. You can grant it in the system settings.
voiceMemo.unavailable: This device cannot record — it has no microphone, or the app is not allowed to use it.
voiceMemo.failed: The recording stopped. Nothing was saved.
voiceMemo.reason: Plainva records a voice memo only when you start one. The recording stays as a file in your vault; it is not sent anywhere.

journal.title: Journal
journal.captureHintTouch: Goes into the daily note with the current time.
journal.undoFailed: The entry could not be taken back — the note has changed since.
journal.failedUnplaceable: The entry found no place in the daily note — is a code block left open there? Nothing was written.
journal.failedChanged: The daily note kept changing, so nothing was written. Please try again.
journal.failedNoNote: The daily note could not be created.
journal.failedMissing: The entry is no longer in the note — the list has been updated.
journal.emptyText: A thought, a line, a time. Entries are plain list lines under the heading “{{heading}}” of the daily note.
journal.emptyFilteredText: No entry of the loaded days passes the filter. “Load older” looks further back.
journal.sideEmpty: No entries for this day yet.

quickCapture.enable: Capture from anywhere with a system-wide shortcut
quickCapture.enableDesc: Opens a small window with the journal's entry field, even while another application is in front. It works as long as Plainva is running — in the tray, too.
quickCapture.recording: Press the new shortcut now … Esc cancels.
quickCapture.needsModifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or the Windows/Command key together with another key.
quickCapture.unsupportedKey: A system-wide shortcut cannot end in this key.
quickCapture.failedTaken: The shortcut could not be registered — another application probably uses it. Please choose a different one.
quickCapture.failedInvalid: The system does not accept this shortcut. Please choose a different one.
quickCapture.failedWayland: This desktop session runs on Wayland, which gives applications no system-wide shortcut. The tray entry “Journal entry” and Ctrl+Shift+J inside Plainva lead to the same field.
quickCapture.note: The shortcut belongs to this device and does not travel with the settings profile. While Plainva is not running, nothing answers it.
quickCapture.noVault: No vault is open in Plainva, so there is nowhere to write the entry.
quickCapture.failed: The entry could not be saved. Is Plainva still running?
